paper_reference.table: Table 1 (diffusion baselines) / multivariate forecasting on Stock
notes: Metrics in the paper are MSE/MAE on z-score normalized series (main text).

Supplemental: Adam lr=1e-3, L1 training loss, batch 128, 2000 training iterations, 70/10/20 chronological train/val/test on sliding windows, sampling steps chosen from {1..12} using the validation split.

local_data.comment: Full Diffusion-TS-style stock CSV used by this repo (no date column; 6 numeric columns).

full_data_paper_style_run_2026.config_caveat: Historical local run. This config did not explicitly set model.params.use_revin=True; current Config/stock_paper.yaml does. Do not treat these numbers as current stock_paper.yaml results without re-running.
full_data_paper_style_run_2026.hardware_note: Trained and evaluated on one NVIDIA TITAN RTX; main.py uses cuda when available.
full_data_paper_style_run_2026.split: 70/10/20 chronological sliding windows (CustomDataset three_split), train_ratio=0.7, val_ratio=0.1

training.comment: sampling_timesteps=2 matches validation sweep (see val_sweep_sampling_timesteps); paper selects from {1..12} on val — here ts=2 is optimal on our val split.

test_metrics_zscore_main_py.protocol: Same as main.py: 10 repeated evaluations with seeds 2023..2032; fast_sample uses sigma=0 so runs are identical — mean equals a single run.

delta_vs_paper_table1.interpretation: MAE is within ~0.021 of the paper (ours lower). MSE is substantially lower here than Table 1 (0.094 vs 0.235), so ranking vs paper is not identical on MSE.

val_sweep_sampling_timesteps.note: ts=1 val_mae ~0.25; ts=2 best; ts>=3 monotonically worse on this val split — consistent with fixing sampling_timesteps=2 in YAML.

repo_stock_yaml_80_20_l2.comment: Not comparable to Table 1: L2 loss, 80/20 split, different difficulty.

paper_style_70_10_20_l1_ts1.comment: Much worse MAE than ts=2 — sampling_timesteps matters.

paper_style_70_10_20_l1_ts2.config_caveat: Historical local run; this config did not explicitly enable use_revin. Current Config/stock_paper.yaml uses use_revin=True.
paper_style_70_10_20_l1_ts2.comment: Same metrics as full_data run — config matches stock_paper_full_data_eval except results_folder path.

standalone_notebook_armd_standalone_full.data_split: Current generated standalone defaults to paper-style 70/10/20 chronological sliding-window split (three_split=True, train_ratio=0.7, val_ratio=0.1).
standalone_notebook_armd_standalone_full.loss: Current generated standalone uses LOSS_TYPE='l1', matching Config/stock_paper.yaml and Eq.7.
standalone_notebook_armd_standalone_full.train_steps: QUICK_TEST=False uses 2000 optimizer steps; QUICK_TEST=True is a 100-step smoke test and is not comparable to Table 1.
standalone_notebook_armd_standalone_full.sampling_timesteps: Current generated standalone uses sampling_timesteps=2; this means two reverse updates, with the actual time grid generated by linspace(-1, T-1, steps=3).
standalone_notebook_armd_standalone_full.revin: Current generated standalone sets USE_REVIN=True, matching Config/stock_paper.yaml per-window lookback normalization.
standalone_notebook_armd_standalone_full.metrics_gap_expectation: Notebook metrics depend on local training, QUICK_TEST, CSV, seed, EMA/checkpoint, and hardware. Historical MSE/MAE in this JSON are not current stock_paper.yaml RevIN results unless re-run.

project_code_vs_paper.iterations: Trainer.train_num_steps = YAML max_epochs — 2000 matches supplemental '2000 iterations'.
project_code_vs_paper.metrics_space: Metrics on StandardScaler-transformed data (global fit on full raw series before windowing) — same broad convention as Diffusion-TS-style baselines; not necessarily identical to every author's internal fork.
project_code_vs_paper.ten_runs: main.py averages 10 sampling runs; fast_sample sets diffusion sampling noise to 0 — repeats collapse to one deterministic outcome.
project_code_vs_paper.neg_one_to_one_in_yaml: Ignored in CustomDataset (auto_norm=False) — only z-score applies.
project_code_vs_paper.val_selection: Paper selects sampling_timesteps on val; repo documents ts=2 from sweep — confirmed by scripts/sweep_sampling_timesteps_val.py on val.

why_mse_may_still_differ_from_table1: Different Stock CSV build or split boundary details vs authors' released Diffusion-TS bundle.
Possible seed / minor implementation drift between releases.
Table 1 may aggregate multiple seeds; this repo uses a single training seed (main.py set_seed(2023)).
EMA/checkpoint: optional evaluation at step 1800 vs final step 2000 — main.py evaluates the final in-memory weights after 2000 steps.

stock_tutorial_armd_stock_tutorial.purpose: Lightweight project-import tutorial for learning repository entry points; not the formula-complete standalone paper-to-code guide.
stock_tutorial_armd_stock_tutorial.protocol: Original demo protocol: 80/20 window split, L2 loss, sampling_timesteps=1, short notebook training override.
stock_tutorial_armd_stock_tutorial.comparison_warning: Do not compare this notebook directly to paper Table 1 or standalone paper-style results.
